criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 01, 04, 08 and 09 pass most of the showstopper test. 06 is a knoll of primitives with an empty top half and the cost bar the brightest object; 02 sits on a lit mid-grey floor (bands 0.49/0.68/0.82) with the cite on a plate; 03's node is a hairline pole; 07's bottom third is a grey slab.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One night crossing, one lamp, one hero node; the amber motif changes state on 1, 3, 8 and 9 and the camera moves as declared. 05 is the companion map and 02's grey floor strobes.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; the date is read from c1.published; sources primary; absences checked; c22 scoped. The charge: the cover dek's 'with no server' and frame 4's 'No server in the loop' while the verified c10 (on no surface) describes central server software and a second, larger model; frame 4's dek scopes it, so a stretch, not a fabrication. Lesser: the amber indicator rings are not described by the release, on a labelled diagram.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Clear what happened; the where is the release's framing plus small coastal towns; no public body decided anything beyond the grant on 06; the action on 09 is generic advice.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The hook carries and the turn at 07 into 08 is real; 09 lands on a human decision; 04 repeats the cover; 02 is context used as the stake frame.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Regional and concrete; clean on house rules; flat lines '98.82%, scored on data' and the caption's template close.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat; a fresh night-crossing world; the structure repeats recent institution-release decks with a 'names no' turn.

one_sentence_fix: Put c10 on the deck: scope frame 4's hook to the flood call made on the post, add that readings also go to a central site where a larger model draws maps, and change the cover's 'with no server' to 'without waiting on a server'.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A knoll of primitives with an empty dark top half; the cost bar is the brightest object.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop to 0.6 m and push in so the enclosure, the lensed rail and the panel fill the lower two thirds at true size; sink the bar as a thin lit inlay.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A lit mid-grey floor in the bottom half; the cite on a plate.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Kill the floor fill, pool the lamp under the column bases, remove the plate.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A hairline pole; the SOLAR PANEL and TEMPERATURE leaders' horizontals nearly share a line.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bring the camera in to a third of the width; route the temperature leader at least 40 px below the solar leader.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat grey lit slab in the bottom third.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tighten the pool to the column's base so the slab falls to black within half a metre.
